description: This Swift source file defines structures, enums, and classes related to TLS certificate pinning and TLS session management for a shared Gateway component. It includes functionality for fingerprint storage, migration from UserDefaults to Keychain, and a custom URLSession delegate for handling server trust challenges. The code facilitates secure WebSocket connections with TLS pinning and fingerprint verification.

classes.name: GatewayTLSPinningSession
classes.description: Manages WebSocket sessions with TLS pinning, handling server trust challenges to ensure secure connections.

methods.name: loadFingerprint
methods.description: Loads a fingerprint for a given stableID from the keychain, migrating from UserDefaults if necessary.

methods.name: saveFingerprint
methods.description: Saves a fingerprint for a given stableID into the keychain.

methods.name: clearFingerprint
methods.description: Removes the stored fingerprint associated with a stableID from the keychain and migrations.

methods.name: clearAllFingerprints
methods.description: Removes all stored fingerprints from the keychain and legacy UserDefaults.

methods.name: makeWebSocketTask
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket task configured with TLS pinning parameters.

methods.name: urlSession:didReceive:completionHandler:
methods.description: Handles server trust challenges, performing certificate fingerprint verification and policy enforcement.
